```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggfortify)
```

# Load data 

```{r}
load("../../data/ZIGMM-model-output.rds")
load("../../data/phylum-labels.rds")
```

# Prep 

```{r}
colors <- c("cyan4", "darkgoldenrod2", "darkgreen", "salmon2", "cornflowerblue", "deeppink4") 

gmm.out <- gmm.out %>%
  left_join(phyl_labels) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(padj < 0.05 & abs(estimate) > 1, Phylum, NA),
         label = ifelse(padj < 0.05 & abs(estimate) > 1, microbe, NA))
```

# Plot 

```{r}
gmm.out %>%
  filter(padj < 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), label= label)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), color = Phylum)) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, na.value = "honeydew3") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  xlab("log2foldchange") +
  ylab("log10(p-value)") +
  theme(legend.position =  "none") + # legend matches stacked bar 
  guides(color = guide_legend(na.translate = FALSE))

```
